cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, concurrent.futures, re, time
# --- obscurify: sudah teruji chat 99/99, ambil ulang saldo terbaru ---
d=json.load(open('/tmp/ob_live.json'))
funded=[x for x in d if (x['saldo'] or 0)>0]
def bal_ob(x):
    r=urllib.request.Request('https://obscurify.ai/get_user_balance',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+x['key']})
    try: return x, json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=30)).get('balance')
    except Exception: return x,None
out=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(10) as ex:
    for x,b in ex.map(bal_ob,funded):
        if b and b>0: out.append({'akun':x['akun'],'key':x['key'],'saldo':round(b,4)})
out.sort(key=lambda z:-z['saldo'])
with open('ob_ready.txt','w') as f:
    f.write("# obscurify — key TERUJI CHAT OK, diurutkan saldo terbesar\n")
    f.write(f"# total {len(out)} key | saldo ${sum(x['saldo'] for x in out):.2f} | {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}\n")
    f.write("# format: nomor_akun | api_key | saldo\n")
    for x in out: f.write(f"{x['akun']} | {x['key']} | ${x['saldo']:.4f}\n")
print("obscurify siap pakai:",len(out),"total $%.2f"%sum(x['saldo'] for x in out))
EOF
